senses.gloss: ली (I) vt. 1P (pres. लयति) To melt, to liquefy.

ली (II) vi. 4Ā (pp. लीन; pres. लीयते) 1. To adhere or stick together, to cling to; 2. to lurk in, to hide in, to rest on, कुमुदमपि गतेऽस्तं लीयते चंद्रबिंबे Rt.iii.22, R.iii.9; 3. to be dissolved; 4. to be sticky; 5. to be devoted to; 6. to vanish, to disappear.With अभि-, to cover, to spread over, पश्चादुच्चैर्भुजतरुवनं मंडलेनाभिलीनः Megh.i.36.With आ-, 1. to cover, to besmear, तटेष्वालीनचंदनौ R.iv.51; 2. to lurk in, to hide in.With नि-, 1. to lie down, to alight, सरोजैश्च निलीनभृंगैः Bt.ii.5, xiv.76; 2. to conceal oneself, (with an abl.), गुहास्वन्ये न्यलेषत Bt.xv.22; 3. to perish.With प्र-, 1. to be absorbed in, रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयंते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके Bg.viii.18; 2. to disappear, to vanish.With वि-, 1. to cleave to, to cling to; 2. to settle on, पुरोऽस्य यावन्न भुवि व्यलीयत Sis.i.12; 3. to be dissolved, to melt away; 4. to vanish, to disappear, to perish.With सम्-, 1. to cling to; 2. to lie down, to be concealed; 3. to melt away.
ली (III) vi. 9P (pres. लिनाति) 1. To adhere; 2. to melt, to be absorbed.With to melt away.
ली Caus. (लीनयति-ते, लालयति-ते, लापयति-ते, लाययति-ते) to melt, to liquefy, to dissolve. (According to Pāṇini, the form लापयते is used in the sense of ‘to obtain honour,’ e.g. जटाभिर्लापयते.)
